title: Case Set Seed Data Schema
description: JSON Schema for Rubik's Cube case set seed data files (seeddata_caseset_*.json). Case sets are groupings of related method cases (e.g., 'F2L', 'OLL', 'PLL').

code.description: Unique code identifier for the case set (e.g., 'f2l-fr', 'oll', 'pll', '2x2-cll-with-algs')

name.description: Display name for the case set

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle or brief description of the case set

pattern_from.description: Pattern state before applying this case set (e.g., 'F2L Complete', 'Opposite Face Oriented')

pattern_to.description: Pattern state after applying this case set (e.g., 'Solved', 'Last Layer Oriented')

expected_count.description: Expected number of cases in this case set (0 for empty/placeholder sets, used for validation)

category.description: Category classification for organizing case sets (e.g., 'cfop', 'beginner', '2x2 - CLL Method')

case_ids.description: Optional array of case references for subset case sets. Populated from lib_caseset_cases junction table. Enables M:N relationship where one case can appear in multiple case sets.

code.description: Human-readable code of the referenced case (e.g., 'CLL-AS-01', 'OLL-01', 'F2L-01-FR')

items.description: Reference to a case with both UUID and code for human readability

created_at.description: Creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format with timezone

description: Array must contain at least one case set
